scientific_integrity: New analytic theorem about a stated mean-field next-generation matrix. Verification tests do not constitute a proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a large-population fixed-total-contact planted-partition mean-field invasion calculation.
Requires identical positive mean susceptibility-transmissibility products across groups and common exponential recovery rate.
Does not determine finite stochastic outbreak probabilities or nonlinear epidemic final sizes.
Historical priority awaits independent scholarly assessment.
title: A sharp population-moment envelope for epidemic invasion under fixed-budget community mixing
